scripts.start:serve: cross-env REACT_APP_ENABLE_SOURCE_MAPS=false node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const p=process.env.REACT_APP_PORT||process.env.PORT||3000;const host=process.env.HOST||'0.0.0.0';process.env.REACT_APP_PORT=p;process.env.PORT=p;process.env.HOST=host;process.env.CI=process.env.CI||'true';process.env.BROWSER='none';let memOpt=(process.env.NODE_OPTIONS&&process.env.NODE_OPTIONS.includes('--max-old-space-size'))?process.env.NODE_OPTIONS:'--max-old-space-size=128';memOpt=memOpt.replace(/--max-old-space-size=\d+/g,'--max-old-space-size=128');process.env.NODE_OPTIONS=memOpt;const {spawnSync,spawn}=require('child_process');const npmCmd=process.platform==='win32'?'npm.cmd':'npm';const npxCmd=process.platform==='win32'?'npx.cmd':'npx';const buildDir=path.join(process.cwd(),'build');let buildStatus=0;try{if(!(fs.existsSync(buildDir)&&fs.existsSync(path.join(buildDir,'index.html')))){console.log('[recipe_frontend] Building production assets (CI-optimized)...');const r=spawnSync(npmCmd,['run','build:ci'],{stdio:'inherit'});buildStatus=(typeof r.status==='number'?r.status:1);}}catch(e){console.error('[recipe_frontend] build error:',e&&e.message);buildStatus=1;}if(buildStatus!==0){process.exit(buildStatus);}console.log(`[recipe_frontend] Serving static build at http://${host}:${p}`);const args=['serve','-s','build','-L','-n','-C','--single','-l',`${host}:${p}`];const child=spawn(npxCmd,args,{stdio:'inherit'});child.on('spawn',()=>{setTimeout(()=>{try{const hr=spawnSync(npmCmd,['run','healthcheck'],{stdio:'inherit'});if((typeof hr.status==='number'?hr.status:1)!==0)console.warn(`[recipe_frontend] healthcheck failed on ${host}:${p} but continuing to serve.`);}catch(e){console.warn('[recipe_frontend] healthcheck probe skipped:',e&&e.message);} } ,1200);});child.on('exit',(code)=>{process.exit((typeof code==='number'?code:0));});"

scripts.healthcheck: node -e "const http=require('http');let port=Number(process.env.REACT_APP_PORT||process.env.PORT||3000);if(!Number.isFinite(port)||port<=0)port=3000;const hcPath=(process.env.REACT_APP_HEALTHCHECK_PATH&&process.env.REACT_APP_HEALTHCHECK_PATH.trim())||'/health.html';const idxPath='/';const host='127.0.0.1';function check(path){return new Promise((resolve)=>{const opts={host,port,path,timeout:3000};const req=http.get(opts,res=>{let data='';res.on('data',c=>data+=c);res.on('end',()=>{try{const okMeta=/<meta[^>]*name=\"?x-healthcheck\"?[^>]*content=\"?ok\"?[^>]*>/i.test(data||'');const statusOk=res.statusCode===200;console.log(`[healthcheck] url=http://${host}:${port}${path} status=${res.statusCode} meta=${okMeta?'ok':'missing'}`);resolve(statusOk&&okMeta);}catch(e){resolve(false)}});});req.on('timeout',()=>{console.error('[healthcheck] timeout');req.destroy();resolve(false)});req.on('error',e=>{console.error('[healthcheck] error:',e.message);resolve(false)});});} (async()=>{console.log(`[healthcheck] probing port=${port}`);if(await check(hcPath))process.exit(0);if(await check(idxPath))process.exit(0);process.exit(1)})();"
